routes.title: Invitation to the Depths of Defeat

rows.en: ...The test results for the Vermillion recently delivered to TERRA are good.
rows.notes: Helena reports Vermillion test results to Bahbem.

rows.en: I see.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Once we have obtained combat data, we will be able to move on to mass production.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Then...send that to the super robot squad as well. We should get good data in a short time.
rows.notes: That refers to Vermillion; retain the source concealed demonstrative. super robot squad follows campaign convention.

rows.en: Understood.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: By the way, Helena...have you discovered where the Star of Ra Mu is?
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Yes. All that remains is to find out how to open the door.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: There is no doubt that she is the key to the door...
rows.notes: Bahbem to Helena; source specifies a woman but does not name her. Preserve she without identifying her.
uncertain: The woman is intentionally unnamed here; do not infer a name from the concealment.

rows.en: But even I was kept unaware for so many years...
rows.notes: Continues row7. Causative subject is unstated; passive preserves that uncertainty rather than asserting the woman consciously concealed it. Deliberate trailing thought retained.
uncertain: The cause of Bahbem remaining unaware is unstated; passive avoids assigning agency to the unnamed woman.

rows.en: Perhaps we can only wait for the right time to bring forth the Star of Ra Mu.
rows.notes: Bahbem weighs waiting for the Star to appear, rather than claiming certain control over it.

rows.en: Then...what shall we do?
rows.notes: Helena seeks his next instruction; restore the implied question.

rows.en: Let us send them to that place. That will let us judge.
rows.notes: Bahbem directs Helena; they/them and that place intentionally remain unnamed in source.
uncertain: Group and destination remain deliberately unspecified in this exchange.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: ...Helena Bahbem...are you here on behalf of the Foundation?
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: So the Bahbem Foundation has sent someone directly involved...
rows.notes: Thought; Hibiki reflects on the Foundation dispatching one of its own.

rows.en: And what can I do for you?
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: I would like to investigate the Mutron ruins beneath Raideen's Divine Face Rock.
rows.notes: Mutron ruins are under Divine Face Rock, not under Raideen itself.

rows.en: I believe I have refused that request many times before.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Please don't worry...it is only an academic survey.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.
Wordless alarm, preserved.

rows.en: Dr. Hibiki, we have detected several heat signatures underground!
rows.notes: Ignore the known stray closing quote and final empty @ indent in raw body.

rows.en: What's more, they are heading for Mutropolis!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: ! Could they be...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate suspense fragment answered at rows24-26.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: What? There are readings from underwater too!?
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Yes, there's no mistake. They are...!
rows.notes: Deliberate identification fragment; row26 supplies Death Army.

rows.en: So it is the Death Army after all!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Then their objective is the same as last time: to obtain the Star of Ra Mu and Mutron energy...!
rows.notes: Higashiyama infers objectives from the previous attack.

rows.en: But the Star of Ra Mu isn't even here...
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.
Wordless silence used at both s06e30:213 and :269; latter follows the ruins-target inference.

rows.en: We have made arrangements too, but why not ask #部隊名 for help, just to be safe?
rows.notes: Helena recommends Hibiki/Higashiyama request help from the runtime squad name; her own provision is Vermillion.

rows.en: I've already contacted them, but what arrangements have you made?
rows.notes: Higashiyama already contacted the squad and asks what Helena arranged.

rows.en: They will be here shortly.
rows.notes: They is the imminent reinforcement; row33 establishes Elvy in Vermillion.

rows.en: ...This is Alpha V1. I have reached the target airspace.
rows.notes: Alpha V1 is Elvy call sign; radio report restores I.

rows.en: Alpha V1...you've been sent straight into actual combat, but there is no problem, is there?
rows.notes: Helena addresses Elvy on immediate combat deployment.

rows.en: Helena Bahbem...!? Why is that woman there?
rows.notes: Thought; Elvy recognizes Helena at Mutropolis.

rows.en: What is wrong, Alpha V1?
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: No, it's nothing.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Then we will collect the combat data here. I look forward to good results, Lieutenant Hadhiyat.
rows.notes: Hadhiyat spelling from Elvy full-name glossary. Helena collects data and expects Elvy results.

rows.en: Roger. I will carry out the mission.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Miss Helena, is that what you were talking about...?
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished question about Helena reinforcement; next row identifies Vermillion.

rows.en: Yes, it is called Vermillion. It is a humanoid weapon developed by the Bahbem Foundation.
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: But its appearance is just like...
rows.notes: Deliberate comparison fragment; next row supplies RahXephon.

rows.en: No, it is not a mass-produced RahXephon.
rows.notes: Helena explicitly denies it is a mass-produced RahXephon; do not import glossary descriptive speculation.

rows.en: It is an anti-MU weapon...a mobile weapon built to provide TERRA with a new fighting force.
rows.notes: Both anti-MU role and new TERRA military strength retained.

rows.en: Certainly, that is not RahXephon...
rows.notes: Thought follows Helena denial.

rows.en: But what is this sinister feeling I get from the Vermillion...?
rows.notes: Thought; Hibiki feels ominous quality from Vermillion.

rows.en: ...With this Vermillion, my mission success rate will rise higher than ever before.
rows.notes: Thought; Elvy expects her own combat success rate to improve.

rows.en: Then I can fight the MU without relying on RahXephon or Kamina...!
rows.notes: Kamina is Ayato surname in source; no replacement with given name.
Wordless reaction; preserve ellipsis and alarm.

rows.en: Answer me, Michelo! Tell me the truth behind the Devil Gundam's revival, and who is pulling the strings!
rows.notes: Separate combat encounter Domon/Michelo; no assumption this follows Elvy thoughts in dialogue.

rows.en: Ha! Do you really think I'll just say, "Yes, of course," and answer you!?
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: I knew you'd say that! In that case...
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: You'll ask with your fists!? You one-trick bastard!!
rows.notes: Michelo mocks Domon predictable reliance on fists; preserve insult force.

rows.en: Come on, you macaroni bastard! I'll fill you full of holes!
rows.notes: Chibodee uses Italian food-based ethnic insult and bullet threat; preserve both.

rows.en: American jokes sure are boring!!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: You just won't give it a rest! Yakitori, fried chicken, Peking duck...I'm running out of recipes!
rows.notes: Bird-themed recipe taunt retains yakitori, fried chicken and Peking duck.

rows.en: Y-you bastard!! You treat me like a chicken, and it really ruffles my feathers!!
rows.notes: Chicken crest anger pun becomes ruffles my feathers, keeping anger and bird joke.
uncertain: Crest/anger pun adapted to ruffles my feathers; exact Japanese wordplay cannot be reproduced.

rows.en: Come on, you pompous bastard! I'll teach you what Italian elegance is all about!
rows.notes: Michelo challenges George; Italian dandyism rendered spoken elegance.

rows.en: A man drowning in power and desire has no right to speak of elegance!
rows.notes: George rebukes Michelo claim to sophistication; power and desire both retained.

rows.en: It seems you and I share an unwelcome connection...!
rows.notes: Argo addresses Michelo and resents repeated encounters; no invented past event.

rows.en: Shut up! I'll put an end to that today!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Today you're going to spill it! Tell me the truth about the Devil Gundam's revival!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: If you want to know so badly, come along with us. Let's have some fun together again!!
rows.notes: Michelo invites Allenby back to their side; row64-65 repudiates her previous controlled self.

rows.en: I told you before! I'm not the same person I was back then!
rows.notes: Allenby contrasts current self with her former state; later rows80-81 identify DG Cell absorption.

rows.en: I'll never join you again!!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: I won't be beaten by some woman who isn't even a Gundam Fighter!
rows.notes: New encounter with Rain, not a denial Allenby is a Gundam Fighter; source-directed misogyny retained.

rows.en: Be quiet! I will never forgive anyone who sides with the Devil Gundam!!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Now I remember you! To think that Grim Reaper Kyral is playing at being a hero!
rows.notes: New encounter with Kyral; sourced Grim Reaper nickname.

rows.en: You laugh and call it a game...but now I devote this tainted life to fighting for the good of the world!
rows.notes: Kyral accepts tainted past and commits remaining life to worldly good.

rows.en: May you pass into paradise! I will strike you down, even if I die with you!
rows.notes: Buddhist death invocation translated as paradise, with explicit mutual-death threat.
uncertain: Paradise renders the Buddhist gokuraku death invocation; doctrinal nuance is compressed into spoken English.

rows.en: Come at me with your prized Godbird! I'll show you which of us deserves to be the bird that soars through the sky!
rows.notes: New encounter with Akira; source Godbird fixed glossary form.

rows.en: Here I come! Raideen will never lose to the likes of you!!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Oh...so this is...the Bahbem Foundation's new model!
rows.notes: New encounter with Elvy; Michelo knows Vermillion development origin.

rows.en: You...how do you know that!?
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: It takes one snake to know another! Well, since we've met on the battlefield, we have to fight!
rows.notes: Underworld knowledge proverb preserved with snake metaphor, no newly invented literal snake character.
uncertain: Snake proverb retains its image; means insiders know insiders, rather than literal snakes.

rows.en: Shut up! With this Vermillion, I have nothing to fear!!
rows.notes: Adjacent event dialogue establishes speaker, listener and subject; source tone retained.

rows.en: Chapman! This is no place for you to live...return to the underworld!!
rows.notes: New encounter with resurrected Chapman; death/underworld threat retained.

rows.en: You've come at last, Saucer Beast!
rows.notes: New encounter with Walter Gundam: Duke mistakes its saucer silhouette for a Saucer Beast.

rows.en: You're wrong, brother!! It does look like one, but that's a Gundam!
rows.notes: Maria corrects Duke; brother retained as direct address, Walter identification established by row80.

rows.en: Walter Gundam... I'll bring you down myself...!
rows.notes: Allenby addresses Walter Gundam; connected motivation follows in81.

rows.en: So I never forget how weak I was when the DG Cells took me over!
rows.notes: Dependent continuation of80 retained at matching row boundary; restores Allenby as subject.

rows.en: Higashiyama, don't you think the enemy's movements are strange?
Indeed. Their target may be Divine Face Rock, rather than Mutropolis.
rows.notes: Higashiyama infers their target, not a confirmed attack order.

rows.en: Could they be after the Mutron ruins underground there...!?
...Alpha V1, make sure you stop the enemy units. You must not let them approach Divine Face Rock.
Divine Face Rock...!?
You mean that thing!?
Yes, the cradle of the divine bird-man... Use the Vermillion to defend that place.
rows.notes: Keeps symbolic divine bird-man wording without substituting a revealed identity.
uncertain: Divine bird-man is source imagery; exact licensed phrase unverified.

rows.en: She expects me to handle enemies in the air and on the ground with just one machine...!
rows.notes: Helena is the implied issuer of the order to Elvy.

rows.en: Fine, I'll do it. When I settle things with the MU, I'll have to face much worse than this anyway.
1. An enemy unit enters Divine Face Rock.@2. Even one allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Defeat conditions; exact two plain lines retained.

rows.en: Hya-ha-ha-ha! Looks like I got here a step ahead of you!!
Tch! He's in a nasty spot!
This is bad! At this rate, the Vermillion and Divine Face Rock will...!
rows.notes: Retained deliberate unfinished warning; ending not supplied.

rows.en: Fall back, Lieutenant! You can't handle this alone!
No, I'll show you I can handle it!
I've got no use for the likes of you! Get the hell out of here!!
Where did these guys come from!?
Ha-ha-ha-ha! Diiiie!!
Gah!!
What!?
...Unclean dead who have strayed into this world. The demons of hell await your return...!
rows.notes: Kyral entrance, identity still hidden as ???; Buddhist afterlife register.

rows.en: Y-you're!!
rows.notes: Retained deliberate interrupted recognition.

rows.en: It is the Grim Reaper's duty to guide the dead...! I, Kyral Mekirel, have come to lead you to the underworld.
rows.notes: Kyral introduces himself as guide to the underworld; Buddhist religious tone.

rows.en: Hah, you're just a washed-up old fool! Can't you see my troops? Or did you come looking for a place to die?
Heh heh heh... These eyes have no light. Behind my eyelids I see only hellfire burning the bodies of the dead...!
rows.notes: Blindness confirmed by glossary; source says eyes lack light, without establishing congenital blindness. Final removes draft implication that he has never seen.

rows.en: What!?
Michelo Chariot! My assassin's blade shall sever your ties to this world! This time, pass on to paradise!!
rows.notes: Religious paradise and severing earthly attachments retained.

rows.en: I'm throwing those exact words right back at you!!
That guy... Could he be a Gundam Fighter!?
You there! Domon Kasshu and the others will be here shortly! Until then, we shall hold off the enemy!
rows.notes: Kyral asks Elvy to hold off enemies together pending Domon, not promising Elvy reinforcements alone.

rows.en: R-roger that!
Hm...! They've come!
Elvy, are you all right!?
As you can see, Haruka Shitow.
rows.notes: Dry reply to Haruka asking if Elvy is unharmed.

rows.en: More to the point, what's that other machine? Is that a TERRA weapon too?
Huh?
That's TERRA for you... I never thought they'd developed something like that. We can't underestimate them.
N-no, that's not ours. It's...
rows.notes: Retained interrupted correction before Allenby identifies Kyral.

rows.en: Kyral! You're Kyral Mekirel, right!?
Indeed. It has been a long time, Allenby Beardsley... And you, Domon Kasshu.
Yeah, I never expected you to come...!
Think nothing of it. It is our duty to slay those enthralled by that devil... I heard of your battle and came to your aid.
rows.notes: The devil refers to the Devil Gundam; duty to kill retains force.

rows.en: H-hey...! That thing's a Gundam too!?
Yeah. It's called the Mandala Gundam.
H-however you look at it, it's a bobblehead sitting on a temple bell...
rows.notes: Bobblehead renders spring-mounted bobbing doll; temple bell retained. Pharmacy mascot callback at128.
uncertain: Bobblehead is a functional rendering of the bobbing pharmacy mascot; exact cultural toy label unverified.

rows.en: Huh? A bobblehead?
You've never seen one? You know, the ones they have outside pharmacies.
What century are you from?
Easy, easy. Anyway, that outfit... isn't half Mandala-bad, is it?
rows.notes: Localized Mandala/manzara pun using Mandala-bad; maintains dismissive approval rather than a factual claim.
uncertain: Mandala/manzara wordplay cannot be literal in English; localized as Mandala-bad.

rows.en: That joke... Hmm, I'd call it Mandala-mediocre.
rows.notes: Localized answering Mandala pun as Mandala-mediocre; deliberately lame for Rose complaint.
uncertain: Source Mandala punch line localized as Mandala-mediocre; precise Japanese secondary pun remains uncertain.

rows.en: Quit making lame jokes and get out there already!
Yikes! She's getting worse than Sergeant Ben.
rows.notes: She refers to Rose ordering deployment.

rows.en: Hang on, Dad! Director! I'm coming to save you!!
Never mind us! The enemy is after the Mutron ruins! You must not let them take them!
What!? They're after the ruins!?
Then it's just like last time...!
rows.notes: Retained trailing comparison; next Rain row supplies Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: Does that mean they still haven't given up on the Star of Ra Mu!?
Indeed...!
But Dad! That shouldn't even be here, right!?
rows.notes: That is the Star of Ra Mu; restores explicit subject.

rows.en: ...They must intend to find clues to the Star of Ra Mu in the ruins.
In any case, don't let them near Divine Face Rock!
G-got it, Dad!
!? What's wrong, Raideen!?
What happened!?
Raideen's energy readings have risen sharply! We don't know why!
Hah! They're after Raideen's bed! Of course it's getting fired up!
rows.notes: Raideen is the bed metaphor referent, settled by144/148 and Divine Face Rock; explicit name avoids English you/it confusion.

rows.en: No, that's not all. Raideen is on guard against something...
Could it be because the RahXephon has come here?
To Captain Shitow aboard the Nahel Argama. This is Helena Bahbem.
Miss Helena... Just as Itsuki said, it seems the Foundation has begun investigating the ruins directly.
rows.notes: Foundation direct investigation matches Itsuki information; no added revelation.

rows.en: Captain, I'd like to use this opportunity to collect data on joint operations between the Vermillion and RahXephon...
rows.notes: Retained trailing polite request.

rows.en: Have you forbidden the Instrumentalist... I mean, the pilot, Ayato Kamina, from launching?
rows.notes: Preserves Helena correction from Instrumentalist to pilot.

rows.en: Huh...?
Ayato! Why aren't you launching!?
Th-the RahXephon... The RahXephon won't move!
What do you mean!? Megumi!
The pilot has been transported inside, but the heart rate signal is falling...! The quantum condensation reaction is below standard too!
rows.notes: Technical status report; pilot inside yet activation fails.

rows.en: N-no...! Even with Ayato inside!?
Are you saying the RahXephon itself is refusing to launch!?
I-I don't know...! All I know is, it won't move!
rows.notes: Ayato answers Misato: RahXephon itself will not move; subject restored.

rows.en: We have no choice! RahXephon, remain on standby aboard the ship! All other units, engage the enemy!
rows.notes: Bright orders RahXephon to stay aboard and the other units to engage; no omitted imperative subject needs insertion.

rows.en: ...RahXephon is refusing to sortie... Is the Instrumentalist's new awakening near? ...No, that's not it.
rows.notes: Helena considers and rejects an impending new awakening as cause; Instrumentalist is the glossary title.

rows.en: It fears the divine bird-man regaining the star's radiance...
rows.notes: It refers to the sortie-refusing RahXephon in preceding thought. Divine bird-man and star remain symbolic descriptions, following campaign glossary wording.
uncertain: Symbolic divine bird-man/star imagery retained; immediate context suggests Raideen and La Mu's star, but the row does not name them.

rows.en: 1. An enemy unit enters Divine Face Rock@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat conditions. Both explicit source lines and their order preserved.

rows.en: Heh, you're pretty good! But we can't just back down so easily this time!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: After all, its resurrection is close at hand! The more fodder, the better!
rows.notes: Its refers forward to the Devil Gundam; source withholds name until the following question. Fodder keeps contemptuous feeding metaphor.

rows.en: Fodder!?
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: You mean, for the Devil Gundam...!?
rows.notes: Answers fodder in167; keeps deliberate trailing question rather than inventing its unfinished conclusion.

rows.en: Hah! You bastards don't need to know that!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Instead, take this! Your invitation to the depths of hell where we were once sent!!
rows.notes: Threat points to the abyss Michelo and his comrades were sent to; depths of hell carries menace and the invitation image.

rows.en: There are so many...!
rows.notes: Restored there are from the visible enemy reinforcements.

rows.en: W-we'll never see the end of them at this rate!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: So this is what DG Cells can really do. And the damn things are more active than ever...!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Hah! No matter how many of those things show up, they're still just a rabble!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Wait, the enemy isn't all Soldier types! There are Gundam types too!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Hmph. It seems Michelo wasn't the only dead man to emerge from the darkness.
rows.notes: Dead man retains resurrection imagery; following Chapman reveal establishes the referent.
One silence appears at both s06e30:366 and372; both original neighbors read.

rows.en: That's the Grand Gundam...!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Well, well... The champ's back from the dead.
rows.notes: Source champ nickname retained, resurrection made explicit.

rows.en: Who is that man?
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: His name is Gentle Chapman... He was Neo England's Gundam Fighter...
rows.notes: Named identity and former Neo England role retained. Gundam Fighter follows sourced profile.

rows.en: And in a previous battle, DG Cells infected him, reducing him to one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings...
rows.notes: Connects to George's previous introduction; restores he/him rather than leaving noun-only grammar.

rows.en: Hey, champ! You won't get a second rematch!
rows.notes: Second rematch retained as a threat that Chapman will not survive for another return; no invented previous match count.
uncertain: Second rematch is deliberately literal; the scene establishes Chapman's resurrection but does not enumerate earlier rematches.

rows.en: He says he can't forget his grudge against you bastards either!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: And Allenby Beardsley! It's time you came back to us!!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Don't be ridiculous! Why would I ever join the likes of you again!?
rows.notes: Allenby's unfinished rhetorical refusal receives its grammatically implicit join verb; she rejects rejoining Michelo.

rows.en: What a cold-hearted woman. You'll make it sad... That Gundam you used to pilot!
rows.notes: It refers to the Walter Gundam, not Chapman. Woman retained in dismissive taunt.

rows.en: W-Walter Gundam!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Don't tell me you plan to use that thing to absorb Allenby!?
rows.notes: You addresses Michelo; that thing is Walter Gundam, the device for taking Allenby in.

rows.en: Come on, remember the old days, Allenby! Then give yourself to it, body and soul!
rows.notes: It refers to Walter Gundam. Body and soul retains coercive total surrender.

rows.en: Then everything will be yours to command!!
rows.notes: Michelo promises total control in exchange for surrender, not control over Allenby by another person.
Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Allenby...!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Don't worry, Domon. I don't need anything like that anymore.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: No matter how many times it rises again... Even if it comes for my mind and body, I'll never make that same mistake again...!
rows.notes: Mind/body both retained, plus repeated resurrection and refusal to repeat mistake.

rows.en: You...
rows.notes: Deliberate emotional trailing address retained.

rows.en: Heh, it was none other than... you, Rain, Domon and the others who gave me the reason and the strength to feel that way.
rows.notes: Rain, Domon and the others are the people who inspired and empowered Allenby. Direct you addresses Rain; others retained.

rows.en: That's why I won't lose!!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Hmm... You've grown so much since then, Allenby.
rows.notes: Kyral reflects on Allenby's growth since earlier events; second-person internal address retained.

rows.en: Watch me, Rain, Domon! I'll smash that cursed past to pieces with my fists!!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Urgh...! Y-you bastards...!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: B-but... As long as the Devil Gundam exists, I'll keep coming back to life!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Again and again and again! Don't you ever forget that!!
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Captain, all enemy unit signals have disappeared.
How are Mutropolis and Divine Face Rock?
rows.notes: Restored how are as Bright asks for a status report, answered by205.

rows.en: Director Higashiyama reports that they have taken damage from the enemy attack, but it is within acceptable limits.
rows.notes: Director Higashiyama is report source; enemy attack, damage, and tolerable extent all retained.

rows.en: I see... What about RahXephon?
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: We still can't get it to activate.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: I knew Raideen was involved in the cause... No, there's no doubt something here is involved.
rows.notes: Haruka corrects her initial Raideen suspicion to something at this location; no new identity supplied.

rows.en: ...All right. Bring all units aboard.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Roger!
I am Lieutenant Elvy Hadhiyat. As of today, I have been transferred to #部隊名.
rows.notes: Full glossary Elvy Hadhiyat retained; source army lieutenant translated without promotion to captain from biographical squad role.

rows.en: I look forward to your support from here on.
rows.notes: Newly assigned Elvy requests her colleagues' future support, not offers herself as someone to rely on.

rows.en: Very well.
Elvy, I never imagined you'd join our unit...
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Yes, the decision also lets us run various tests on TERRA's humanoid weapon... the Vermillion.
rows.notes: Tests are an additional purpose of the transfer; humanoid weapon and TERRA both retained.

rows.en: Once those are complete, it will be mass-produced as one of our trump cards against the Mu.
rows.notes: It is Vermillion, not RahXephon; Mu is the enemy organization.

rows.en: A trump card against the Mu...
rows.notes: Deliberate reflective noun fragment echoing214 retained.

rows.en: Bright, it has been a long time.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Not since the Devil Gundam incident... Will you be joining us from now on?
rows.notes: Restored will you be joining us in Bright's question to Kyral.

rows.en: Of course. That is why I have come.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: That helps. Especially now, with our forces split in two for Operation Moonraker.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Captain Bright Noa... I have a request for you and your people.
rows.notes: Full named address with source army colonel rank retained. Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank [jp] to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: What is it?
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Please proceed to TERRA headquarters in Nirai Kanai now. ...There is also the matter of RahXephon.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: But... RahXephon returned to normal once we left Mutropolis...
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Even so, we need to investigate it as a precaution.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Understood. This ship will now set course for Nirai Kanai.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Captain, we've finished parking in La Vie en Rose.
rows.notes: Parking preserves Hari's casual garage metaphor for docking inside La Vie en Rose.

rows.en: Understood.
And we have an incoming transmission from their acting captain.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Then please put it through.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: ...I am Emary Ounce, acting captain of La Vie en Rose.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Thank you for all your hard work on the operation in the Spiral Castle sector.
rows.notes: Spiral Castle sector translates the surrounding space, not its interior.

rows.en: No, the hard part is still ahead of us.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Yes, it is... Well then, we'll begin resupplying you.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Ruri asks Emary to carry out resupply; direction kept as I am counting on you.

rows.en: Also, this ship will now depart for the operation area, so...
rows.notes: Trailing causal so is deliberately completed by next row235.

rows.en: I think we can shorten the Nadesico's travel time.
rows.notes: La Vie en Rose carrying the Nadesico will shorten its transit; no extra transport explanation inserted.

rows.en: ...Acting Captain Emary, how is the battle going?
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: The Dragoon force has now advanced to just before the enemy's third defensive line.
rows.notes: To just before preserves positions short of the third line, not a breakthrough.

rows.en: Oh... They're somewhat ahead of schedule.
rows.notes: Context and adjacent replies checked; source meaning and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Yes. Apparently, the enemy's counterattack weakened considerably just a short while ago.
rows.notes: Apparently preserves report-based certainty; incoming context240..245 discusses command disruption.

rows.en: I wonder what happened?
Their chain of command probably fell into confusion, but...
Something similar happened at A Baoa Qu back then.
rows.notes: A Baoa Qu verified by orchestrator against Akurasu Bright Noa and official Gundam.info; initial glossary gap resolved.

rows.en: You mean when Gihren Zabi was assassinated?
Yeah.
Could the same thing have happened in Giganos...?
rows.notes: Amuro compares the command collapse with the preceding Gihren assassination allusion; restores the same-event predicate.

rows.en: 1. Destroy the Mass Driver within 5 turns.
1. Fail to destroy the Mass Driver within 5 turns.@2. Any allied unit is shot down.
Captain, look over there!
Our machines are intact!
Yes, I thought they had been destroyed long ago...!
Captain Plato, this way! Your machines are ready to launch!
Who are you...?!
rows.notes: Interrogative completed as a question about the unexpected allied soldiers.

rows.en: We share the same cause as you and your men, Captain!
Thank you...! I owe you one!
rows.notes: Grateful apology followed by explicit indebtedness; spoken thank-you rendering.

rows.en: Don't mention it! You must escape at once!
The Federation forces have already broken through the fourth defense line!
What, they've already gotten that far?!
Y-yes...!
Then we'll take advantage of the situation! Board your machines!
Yes, sir!
rows.notes: Acknowledgment works for both boarding at s06s30:220 and withdrawal at :288.

rows.en: Good luck in battle, Captain Meio Plato...!
Captain, I've unlocked the gate!
Yes. Dorchenov's supporters are probably waiting outside in their machines...
I'll open a way through. You must use that chance to escape.
What?!
What do you mean, Captain?!
...I will destroy the Mass Driver, in accordance with the late Marshal Guiltorre's wishes.
rows.notes: Late marshal is explicit in the last-wishes wording.

rows.en: Th-then we will accompany you!
No. You are to withdraw from this base.
N-no! We have no intention of running away now!!
That's an order!
C-Captain...!!
...Dorchenov will certainly use the Mass Driver to retaliate against the Federation.
I must stop that at any cost.
B-but...!
Listen. Gather the soldiers who support our cause, and wait for a chance to rise again.
But then you'll be...!
rows.notes: Source deliberately breaks off over the danger to Meio; retained unfinished predicate.
uncertain: Deliberate unfinished warning retained; source leaves the fate unstated.

rows.en: ...You needn't worry about me.
...U-understood, Captain. We will obey your orders.
But we will not say farewell.
We believe in you, Captain, and will await your return.
...I'm sorry.
rows.notes: Apologetic gratitude to subordinates obeying the separation order.

rows.en: Captain, I'll send you the Mass Driver's structural data. To stop it from firing...
rows.notes: Sentence remains unfinished here and continues in row287.
uncertain: Source deliberately trails off into row287.

rows.en: You must destroy that section.
Understood.
The Mass Driver is already preparing to fire. Please destroy the point I indicated within five minutes from now.
Understood. Here we go!!
Prepare yourself, you traitor Dorchenov!
What are you saying, Captain Plato?! You assassinated Marshal Guiltorre and fled! You're the traitor!
You...!
Officers and soldiers of Giganos! I, Dorchenov, will slay the traitor Meio Plato!
All of you, follow my lead!!
This man's aura... It's different from any enemy I've faced before...!
Impressive, Amuro Ray. But now that you've peered into the darkness of my heart, I shall invite you to the underworld!
Vanish into the darkness of ignorance, Newtype...!
uncertain: Buddhist mumyo rendered as ignorance; darkness also evokes literal blindness.

rows.en: I came back from there...! To defeat people like you who keep starting wars...!
You people in Mokuren lived on Jupiter and despaired at humanity's foolishness, didn't you?!
Then why do you keep repeating something as stupid as war?!
I have no ideology or beliefs... I merely carry out my mission...!
Even you, who have lived in the place farthest from Earth, still cling to it...
rows.notes: Cross-row question setup continues in row304; Earth referent explicit.
uncertain: Source cross-row question structure retained as trailing setup.

rows.en: Is it because human souls are still bound by gravity...?!
rows.notes: Completes the question begun in row303.

rows.en: Humans are nothing more than humans. Wherever humans are, there is desire, and that is why we exist...!
How pitiful, boy. Will your short life end here...?!
I won't let that happen!
We have a reason we can't afford to lose!
Hokushin! You of all people... I'll defeat you with these fists!
rows.notes: Preserves emphatic repeated focus on Hokushin.

rows.en: Foolish... You have such formidable power, yet you lose yourself over a single woman.
I'm not fighting you just for Erika's sake!
Defeating you and whoever is behind you, and restoring peace to this universe... That is my wish, and Erika's too!!
rows.notes: Unknown backer stays gender neutral.

rows.en: This man's heart... It seems utterly empty...! Yet its depths are like darkness!
rows.notes: Empty refers to the mind, not sky; contrast with dark depths follows.

rows.en: Indeed...! We need neither ideals nor a future... We merely fulfill our mission!
What?! Captain Plato is heading for the Mass Driver?!
Y-yes!
Damn you, Meio Plato! You intend to destroy our army's trump card at a time like this?!!
Prepare my Metal Armor! If it has come to this, I will slay him myself!!
Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov! The Federation forces are approaching the final defense line!
rows.notes: Army rank supplied by source; retained Lieutenant Colonel.

rows.en: Damn it, why are you struggling with mere Federation mass-produced machines?! Tell the troops to hold the line to the death!!
Yes, sir!!
rows.notes: Military acknowledgment reused in events 10 and 13; addressed to Dorchenov in all three uses.

rows.en: And where is Hokushin?! Why hasn't he come to help us?!
W-we haven't heard from them!
Tch, damn Jovians...! Are they planning to sit back and see who wins?!
rows.notes: Jovians refers to Hokushin and his group. Sitting back to see who wins carries the opportunistic sense.

rows.en: Anyway, hurry up and fire the mass driver!!
Bring down the iron hammer of our wrath on the ignorant fools of Earth and the Federation!!
It's time...! All of you, withdraw at once!
rows.notes: Meio orders Dan, Karl and Welner to withdraw; the reused Dan acknowledgment intervenes in actual event order.

rows.en: Good luck in battle, Captain!!
Please be sure to come back to us!!
Dan, Karl, Welner... Don't you die.
rows.notes: Thought addressed mentally to the three retreating subordinates; imperative subject is you.

rows.en: You traitor who murdered His Excellency the Marshal! This is as far as you go!
Dorchenov...!!
rows.notes: Name-only recognition exclamation retained.

rows.en: I cannot afford to lose the mass driver here! Accept your fate and let me strike you down!
...Perhaps this is a fitting end for the Blue Hawk of Giganos after all...?
rows.notes: Meio considers his own death while opposing Dorchenov; source uses the full established Blue Hawk title.

rows.en: Fwahahaha! Finish off the traitor! Cut him to pieeeeces!!
But even if it costs me my life, I will not let you fire the mass driver! Behold the full force of the Hawk's strike!!
rows.notes: The Hawk is Meio himself; strike is descriptive rather than an imported weapon name.

rows.en: Damn you, Meio Plato! I cannot die here!
Nwoooah?! Th-the mass driver!!
rows.notes: Retained deliberate unfinished exclamation about the damaged mass driver.

rows.en: Now you've lost your trump card...!
D-damn you! Damn you!! Daaaamn you!! How dare you destroy the mass driver!!
...The Federation forces are almost here. Your fate is sealed now, Dorchenov.
Shut up! Shut uuuup!! That's my line!!
Then at least I'll send you to hell!!

rows.notes: Pure startled punctuation retained; no invented speech.

rows.en: You can't escape, no matter how you struggle! Meio Plato!!
I am the man they called the Hawk of Giganos... I know where I should meet my death.
Then diiiiie!!
Your Excellency, I have kept my promise...
rows.notes: Meio addresses the Marshal in his apparent final moments. The title stays; no name added.

rows.en: Now... I have no regrets left...
Gwahahaha! I have slain the traitor!! Gwahahahahaha!!
Wh-what?!
Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov, please return at once! The enemy has broken through our final defensive line!!
They'll be here any moment!!
D-damn it!! Send every remaining Metal Armor to intercept them!!
Annihilate them right at the entrance!!
rows.notes: At the entrance renders the last-ditch defensive idiom; no literal waterfront is implied in this base scene.

rows.en: Captain! We've entered the enemy base area!
Destroying the mass driver is our top priority. Prepare to fire the Gravity Blast.
Yes! ...Wait, huh?!
Is something wrong?
Th-the mass driver... It's already been destroyed!
Wh-what's going on?!
I-I don't know, but the chamber block has definitely been badly damaged...
rows.notes: Retained trailing report. Chamber block is descriptive technical wording; no mechanics added.
uncertain: Exact independent canonical English term for chamber block not established; kept source-literal descriptive wording.

rows.en: ...It seems infighting has broken out on the enemy side at this late stage.
Whatever the reason, we got lucky! Let's charge straight through in one go!!
Agreed. Everyone, please launch at once.
...Then let's bring Operation Moonraker to a close.
All of you, enter the base's underground levels and reach its deepest section. Secure the enemy's central command area.
rows.notes: Ruri orders the deployed units to the deepest underground section and to secure enemy central command.

rows.en: Understood.
rows.notes: Amuro acknowledges Bright's order.

rows.en: Oh, and one more thing... Please destroy that wall over there to get into the central command area.
All right, commence the attack.
1. An allied unit reaches enemy central command
rows.notes: Plain victory condition; one line retained.

rows.en: 1. Allied mothership shot down@2. All other allied units destroyed
rows.notes: Plain defeat conditions; two lines retained, and the second explicitly excludes the mothership.

rows.en: Lieutenant Colonel! Enemy machines have entered Interior Area 1!!
Damn it, launch the interceptors!!
...Grrr, is this the end for me...?!
rows.notes: All-source occurrence is a thought while the deduplicated owner labels it dialogue. Body fits both; source labels unchanged.

rows.en: But even if I lose this place, I still have that...!
rows.notes: That remains unspecified as in source; no later revelation imported. All-source occurrence is a thought.
uncertain: The referent of that is deliberately unspecified in this scene.

rows.en: Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov! They've broken through Area 1!!
?! L-Lieutenant Colonel?! Where have you gone?!
C-Captain! There's a Boson particle reading inside the enemy base!!
...We will not let you go any farther.
Dorchenov is still of use to us.
You will fight us for a little while.
rows.notes: Hokushin's Six demand that the squad fight them; requester/listener direction preserved.

rows.en: Hokushin's Six...!!
rows.notes: Name-only identification exclamation retained.

rows.en: Those bastards followed us even here!!
Well, well... Those guys are surprisingly loyal, aren't they?
rows.notes: Saburota's flippant surprise at the enemy protecting Dorchenov, not a sincere ally compliment.

rows.en: Damn them, they're trying to stop us in our tracks!!
Heh! We can scatter that lot in no time!
No, we mustn't underestimate them. And Hokushin is nowhere to be seen...!
Tch! What the hell is it this time?!
I-it's another Boson particle reading!
Could it be Hokushin?!
rows.notes: The guess refers to the new Boson reading; Akito arrives instead in the intervening reused line.
Repeated deliberate silence at all four actual uses.

rows.en: A-Akito!!
rows.notes: Stuttered name-only call retained.

rows.en: Akito, answer me! Akito!!
...Where is he?
rows.notes: He is Hokushin, established by Kamille and Kazuya immediately before Akito appears. Not Dorchenov.

rows.en: We have no need to answer you.
Find him with your own eyes.
If you can, that is. Hehehe.
rows.notes: Conditional taunting fragment continues row 394; intentionally unfinished conditional retained.

rows.en: ...Let's go, Lapis.
rows.notes: Akito directs Lapis to go with him, not a response to Ryoko's calls.

rows.en: Akito! Why won't you answer me?! What the hell has happened to you?!
...Captain, what do we do?
rows.notes: Saburota asks Ruri how to respond to Akito's appearance/nonresponse.

rows.en: ...For now, we will give the operation priority.
rows.notes: Ruri prioritizes the ongoing operation for now; this does not permanently reject helping Akito.

rows.en: ...Are you sure that's all right...?
rows.notes: Vega/Ruri exchange after Akito departs. Vega questions Ruri prioritizing the operation over Akito; reused affirmative follows.
